source_surface_binding.boundary: Inferred visual source-surface association; four-weight fields are diagnostics and the native ABI 5 retains the full field. Not measured skin weights, material stiffness, thickness, mass, contact, mechanical deformation or clinical registration.
source_surface_binding.screening: inverse exact source bone-to-skin projection gap; mean confidence per distinct body then mean across bodies; target shares confidence proportionally; no mesh-edge-dependent seed penalty
source_surface_binding.seam_policy: exact source world-coordinate equality only; solve quotient graph and expand to unchanged source vertex order; no proximity tolerance or hole capping
source_surface_binding.seed_rule: centroid_and_64_stratified_source_bone_vertices_projected_to_source_skin; sample must lie within source skin geodesic bone diameter bound plus twice centroid projection gap

independent_field_certificate.boundary: Independent source seed and full graph-equation certificate; not measured anatomical skin weights or deformation qualification.

source_topology.boundary: Source topology only. Even a closed-oriented candidate does not admit volume, material, contact or clinical anatomy.
source_topology.identification: exact Float64 source world-coordinate equality; no proximity tolerance

boundary: Nine actual native source poses and all source vertices/triangles/frames/weights checked. Exact source seam continuity closes, while added-edge/shape regressions and open source topology are retained. No mechanics, physiological strain, clinical anatomy, volume, standing or whole-Human qualification.
